project: Predictive Maintenance IoT System with MLOps
description: Production-grade predictive maintenance pipeline processing factory IoT sensor data in real-time to predict machine failures before they happen, using FFT features, LSTM + Isolation Forest ensemble, with automated drift detection and retraining.

phases.name: Foundation & IoT Data Ingestion
phases.theme: MQTT broker, Kafka, sensor schemas, data simulation, CI/CD

phases.name: Signal Processing & Feature Engineering
phases.theme: FFT analysis, rolling statistics, anomaly scores, feature store

phases.name: ML Models & Failure Prediction
phases.theme: Isolation Forest, LSTM, ensemble, MLflow, survival analysis

phases.name: Work Order & Alert System
phases.theme: Work order creation, maintenance scheduling, Slack alerts, dashboard

phases.name: Drift Detection & Auto Retraining
phases.theme: Evidently drift, Airflow retraining DAG, validation, canary

phases.name: Hardening, Tests & Documentation
phases.theme: Integration tests, load tests, security, full docs
